reviewRules.completeProjectionMeaning: syntax-only projection completeness; not evidence authenticity or live authority
reviewRules.privateRegisterDigestMeaning: digest binds hidden register bytes but does not publish those bytes
reviewRules.independentReviewMeaning: review reference is required in the projection and must be separately accepted by a human approval gate
reviewRules.uploadState: CAD upload routes remain disabled until a later activation gate
reviewRules.unknownOutcomePolicy: stop new work, retain holds and reconcile only original selectors under separate authority

No merge, deployment, live tests, production/development env or provider/auth/resource changes, secrets, usage/billing changes, enrollment, email/SMS/Slack, store mutation outside reviewed restricted evidence artifacts, CAD upload activation, CAD conversion, private CAD, Sandbox dispatch or branch/worktree cleanup.
